stills.prompt: Extreme close-up at table height along a matte slate-black stone surface. A fine antique-gold (#C6A94F) chain lies taut in a sharp chiselled groove and bends around the edge of a deep dark fissure in the stone; one worn, brighter link is caught against the fissure's lip, the chain pulled tight behind it. The groove is polished smooth where the chain has passed many times. Shallow depth of field: chain and fissure edge sharp, the groove curving away into soft darkness. One warm light from directly above, as from a hanging brass lantern out of frame. Fine dust in the air. Near-black surroundings, strong gold-on-black contrast that reads at phone size. No people, no hands, no glow, no sparks, no lettering. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.

Low angle along a rectangular chart table of matte slate-black stone in a low vaulted room of the same stone. A fine antique-gold (#C6A94F) chain lies in a chiselled groove that runs in one closed loop around three deep dark fissures in the near half of the table; at the loop's near end the chain passes over a small dark bronze sprocket half-recessed in a slot in the stone. Beyond the loop the stone is bare and uncut, running to an arched doorway in the far wall, dark beyond. One enclosed aged-brass lantern hangs above the table and gives a single warm light from directly above. Fine dust. No people, no glow, no portals, no lettering. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.
